reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the rendered redline leaves all three paragraphs unchanged with no counterparty comment, which is the expected output for a compliant finding.

The cited fee/revenue-share provisions (Section 4.1, Exhibit B license fees, Exhibit D application management revenue share) set fixed amounts and contain no most-favoured-nation, 'no less favorable', price-matching or best-pricing language burdening Corio (our party as licensee/customer), so the preferred position (no MFN obligation on Customer) is satisfied.
No Vendor-granted MFN in Customer's favour exists in the cited text, so there is nothing to preserve and the redline guidance (delete Customer obligation, keep Vendor-granted MFN) is inapplicable.
Deterministic checks are empty and consistent with an unchanged, non-actionable compliance record; the rationale's negative keyword search is a reasonable basis for the conclusion.
